verified: Prevost, the Quebec coach builder owned by Volvo Group, unveiled the H3-45 Electric, its first battery-electric motorcoach, equipped with a 540 kWh Volvo battery, 450 kW (600 hp) from two electric motors, and CCS1 plus MCS charging as standard, Electrek reported.
unconfirmed: The 250-mile range figure appears in the headline but not in the article text, and no test standard or independent measurement backs it; the report also gives no price, production start date, or delivery timeline, so it is unclear whether the published specs are final production figures or targets for a vehicle not yet in customers' hands.

verified: 据 Electrek 报道，沃尔沃集团旗下的魁北克客车制造商 Prevost 发布了其首款纯电动长途客车 H3-45 Electric，搭载 540 kWh 沃尔沃电池，双电机合计输出 450 kW（600 hp），并标配 CCS1 与 MCS 充电接口；该车基于 Prevost 在北美最常见的高速公路客车之一 H3-45 平台，仅更换动力系统。
unconfirmed: 标题所称 250 英里续航未在报道正文中给出测试标准或工况，也未说明是标称值还是实测值；价格、投产与交付时间、可选配置以及该车目前是样车还是可订购车型，报道均未提及，需等 Prevost 官方规格表或第三方测试确认。

titles.en: Prevost unveils H3-45 Electric coach with 540 kWh battery and MCS charging
titles.zh: Prevost 发布 H3-45 Electric：540 kWh、600 马力、标配 MCS
